summary: Full-primary-reading checkpoint for the all-parahoric HN-irreducible component theorem, its group-dependent monodromy equivalences and global applications. Reuses existing ADLV, integral shtuka/local-model, diamond recovery and Shimura continuations; proposes a generic crystalline-monodromy continuation. Explicit counterexamples refute the unrestricted quotient lemma and two orbit formulas; their effects on the proof are gated without claiming the main theorem false. Recursive supplier and global-output closure remain open.
